svg.title: AREA 41
svg.desc: Attack the four switches around the platform to open the orange gate. Take 1→1′; use 2→2′ for optional boxes. Drop a Mag on the pad to light this dark room, and retrieve it after clearing. Trigger and clear the traps before holding both switches. The long corridor below is also trapped. Shooting traps: trigger and clear them before holding both switches. Force: drop a Mag for the lights; retrieve it after clearing. These boxes have no traps.
